submission.remediation: Search service is saturated at maximum replica capacity (12/12) with sustained elevated traffic (900+ RPS vs. baseline ~190 RPS). CPU at 95%+, error rate at 10.4%, and rate limiter actively shedding 22-27% of requests. Scaling is currently blocked by infrastructure limits. Investigate the traffic source increase at 13:20:00 to determine if this is legitimate user demand or anomalous traffic. Consider consulting service owner on raising replica limits if infrastructure permits, or implementing client-side load shedding, request prioritization, or per-tenant rate limits for non-critical routes while scaling capacity review occurs.
